notes: Jezero Safe Walk shared grid contract (DE1). All processed grids (dem_20m_crop.tif, elev_dm_i16.bin, slope_u8.bin, ctx_basemap.jpg, hillshade.png) share width, height and bounds exactly. Indexing: row 0 = north, col 0 = west, row-major; index = row*width + col. bounds are outer-corner coordinates of the edge pixels. (lat,lon) -> (row,col), exactly linear: col = floor((lon - bounds.lon_min) / deg_per_px_x); row = floor((bounds.lat_max - lat) / deg_per_px_y); deg_per_px_x = (bounds.lon_max - bounds.lon_min)/width; deg_per_px_y = (bounds.lat_max - bounds.lat_min)/height. Pixel-center decode: lon = bounds.lon_min + (col+0.5)*deg_per_px_x; lat = bounds.lat_max - (row+0.5)*deg_per_px_y. Decode domain is half-open: [lon_min, lon_max) x (lat_min, lat_max]; points exactly on the east/south outer edge yield col == width / row == height and are outside the grid - always range-check 0 <= col < width and 0 <= row < height. elev_dm_i16.bin decode: elev_m = int16_le/elev_scale (10 = decimeters); nodata_elev = -32768. slope_u8.bin decode: slope_deg = byte/slope_scale (4); byte 255 marks edges/unknown -> forbidden (63.75 deg), not NoData. pixel_size_m = GROUND meters at ground_ref_lat 18.5 (slope dx/dy per PLAN 5.3, distances per 5.6); pixel_size_projected_m = CRS grid units (20 m). pixel_m (single scalar for astar.js, PLAN 5.5) = sqrt(pixel_size_m.x * pixel_size_m.y); diagonal step = pixel_m * sqrt(2) (= sqrt(x^2+y^2) to <1e-6 m). requested_frame (PLAN 5.1 four-decimal AOI) lies fully inside bounds (outward pixel snap). Vertical reference: elevations as stored in the source DEM product (docs/sources.md); reconciliation with the rover-track Site frame is Data Scientist scope (PLAN 5.7).
